name: Tab Ultimate – Responsive Tabs Plugin with Block, Shortcode & Widget
author: Themepoints

sections.description:
Tab Ultimate is a fast, accessible WordPress tabs plugin. Build horizontal or vertical tabbed content with a visual builder and a live preview, then place it anywhere with the Gutenberg block, a shortcode or a sidebar widget. No coding needed.

Use it for FAQ tabs, product details tabs, pricing plans, course outlines, event schedules, service lists, documentation and more. Tabs are unlimited, even in the free version.

Live demo | Documentation

Why choose Tab Ultimate?

  • Unlimited tabs in every tab group, free forever
  • Visual builder: drag and drop tabs, duplicate, move up or down, delete
  • Live preview of your real front-end design before you publish
  • Responsive: works on phones, tablets and desktops
  • Accessible: keyboard navigation, screen reader markup, reduced-motion support
  • Fast: scripts and styles load only on pages that show tabs
  • Works without JavaScript: all content is shown if scripts are blocked

Free features

  • Horizontal and vertical tab layouts
  • 6 menu styles, with left, center, right or justified alignment, menu on top or bottom
  • Tab icons from a full icon picker (more than 780 icons) in four positions
  • Optional subtitle under each tab title
  • Scrollable tab menu with arrows and swipe, for groups with many tabs
  • Heading tags (H2 to H6) for tab titles, for SEO and document outline
  • Click or hover to open, adjustable animation speed, auto height, and fade, slide and zoom animations
  • URL hash links so visitors can share a link to a specific tab
  • Full colour, font size, line height and padding controls
  • Rich-text editor with the media uploader in every tab
  • Gutenberg block, shortcode and sidebar widget
  • 2 ready-made templates (FAQ and Product Details), added in one click
  • Duplicate a whole tab group, or any single tab
  • Dashboard with an overview of your tab groups and copy-to-clipboard shortcodes

Tab Ultimate Pro

Upgrade for advanced features. Your existing tabs keep working.

  • Dynamic tabs: build tabs automatically from posts, pages, custom post types or categories
  • Nested tabs: place a tab group inside any tab
  • Conditional and scheduled tabs: show tabs by login status, user role or date range
  • Mobile accordion: turn tabs into tap-friendly sections on small screens
  • Autoplay with pause on hover, and remember the last opened tab
  • Lazy-load videos, maps and embeds in tabs that are not open yet
  • 4 extra menu styles and 9 extra animations
  • Typography controls, tab badges, image and SVG icons
  • Vertical menu position and width, corner radius and spacing controls
  • Custom CSS for each tab group
  • Import and export tab groups as JSON files
  • 8 more ready-made templates (pricing, services, schedule, documentation and more)
  • Elementor widget
  • Priority support

How to show your tabs

  1. Block: add the “Tab Ultimate” block and choose a tab group.
  2. Shortcode: paste [tabsprofree id="123"] into any page, post or widget.
  3. Widget: add the “Tab Ultimate” widget to a sidebar or footer area.
  4. Theme file: echo do_shortcode( '[tabsprofree id="123"]' );
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin go to Plugins > Add New and search for “Tab Ultimate”, or upload the plugin zip.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Open Tab Ultimate > Dashboard, then click New Tab Group.
  4. Add your tabs, choose a style, and click Publish.
  5. Copy the shortcode, or use the Tab Ultimate block, where you want the tabs to appear.

Prefer a head start? Open Tab Ultimate > Templates and click “Use this template”.
sections.faq:
How do I add tabs to a page?

Create a tab group under Tab Ultimate > Add New Tab, publish it, then add the “Tab Ultimate” block to your page and pick the group. You can also paste the shortcode, for example [tabsprofree id="123"].

Is there a limit on the number of tabs?

No. You can add as many tabs as you like in the free version. For long menus, set Tab Menu Overflow to “Scrollable, with arrows”.

Can I make vertical tabs?

Yes. Choose the Vertical layout under Tab Settings. Pro lets you put the menu on the left or right and set its width.

Can I use it for an FAQ or accordion?

Yes. The FAQ template gives you a ready-made FAQ with a side menu. In Pro, turn on Accordion on mobile to turn tabs into tap-to-open sections on small screens.

Can I put videos, images and shortcodes inside tabs?

Yes. Each tab uses the WordPress editor with the media uploader. You can also paste video links on their own line, or add shortcodes.

Does it work with Elementor, Divi and other page builders?

The shortcode works in any builder. Pro adds a native Elementor widget.

Are the tabs accessible?

Yes. Tabs use the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern, support the arrow, Home and End keys, and respect the reduced-motion setting.

Is tab content visible to search engines?

Tab content is part of the page HTML (it is not loaded later), so search engines can read it. You can also wrap tab titles in H2 to H6 heading tags.

Will it slow down my site?

No. Tab Ultimate loads its scripts and styles only on pages that show a tab group.

Can I show a tab only to some visitors, or only for some dates?

Yes, in Pro. Each tab has a “Visibility & schedule” box: show it to everyone, logged-in users, logged-out visitors or one role, and set show-from and show-until dates.

Can I build tabs from my posts or categories?

Yes, in Pro. Dynamic tabs can create one tab per post, or one tab per category that lists its latest posts.

Can I move tab groups to another site?

Yes, in Pro. Use Tab Ultimate > Import / Export to download a tab group as a JSON file and import it elsewhere.

What happens to my tabs if I stop using Pro?

Your tab groups keep working. Pro-only options stop applying, and your content is never deleted.

Where can I get help?

Read the documentation, or contact support from the plugin’s Help page.
sections.changelog:
3.0.0

  • New: Gutenberg block and sidebar widget.
  • New: Dashboard, templates gallery (2 free templates) and duplicate tab group / tab item.
  • New: Scrollable tab menu with arrows, tab subtitles and H2-H6 title tags.
  • New: Unlimited tabs per group.
  • New: Accessible markup (ARIA tabs pattern) and keyboard navigation.
  • New: Tab content is output on the server, so tabs work without JavaScript and without layout jump.
  • New: Full icon picker with more than 780 icons.
  • Pro: Dynamic tabs, nested tabs, conditional and scheduled tabs, lazy-loaded media.
  • Pro: Mobile accordion, autoplay, remember last tab, typography, badges, image and SVG icons.
  • Pro: 4 extra styles, 9 extra animations, Custom CSS, import and export, 8 more templates, Elementor widget.
  • Fix: Duplicate element ids when several tab groups were on one page.
  • Fix: Hover text colour and tab border colour settings now work.
  • Fix: Content clipped at the bottom when auto height was on.
  • Fix: Backslashes in tab content were removed on save.
  • Fix: Tab groups are no longer public front-end pages.
  • Fix: Live preview now shows a clear error message and ignores stray PHP notices.
  • Improved: Admin screens have a new, cleaner design.

2.0.4

  • Fixed: Resolved an issue where newly created accordion tab icons and settings did not persist on the first publish.
  • Fixed: Cleaned up duplicate Visual/Code editor toolbar rendering issues on newly added tab items.
  • Improved: Enhanced JavaScript re-indexing logic for dynamic metabox repeater fields, icon selectors, and TinyMCE editor instances.

2.0.3

  • Refactored entire plugin architecture into modern Object-Oriented Programming (OOP).
  • Optimized dynamic styling by implementing CSS Custom Properties (CSS Variables) injected directly into the main container.
  • Fixed legacy database meta compatibility issues; added robust fallback mechanisms for old meta keys so existing shortcodes work seamlessly without manual re-saves.
  • Corrected variable parameter ordering within the dynamic style builder for accurate border and hover text rendering.
  • Enhanced feature support including full layout options (Horizontal/Vertical), alignments (Left/Center/Right/Justified), menu styles, auto-height, URL hash links, and live preview.
